g.text: DF B3: saved finite-domain negative comparisons
H4 DF10 / H6 DF19 (weighted completion), linear1 Å/STO-3G; P=0; full Hadamard RZ, opt1/seed17. B3 retains the one-body block; it is not whole-Hamiltonian pure RTE.
All original 40 cells and three saved baseline families are shown. The repeated B3 value is drawn once per cell; baseline cohorts are retained in DISPLAY_DATA.csv.
Original finite-domain result: B3 lower G in 0/40 conditions against each saved baseline family. No universal impossibility claim. Only comparison-difference SE is saved
here; no individual SE is invented.
